versions.changelog:
- Initial release of conversation-saver.
- Automatically extracts and classifies key facts from conversation history using a rule-based and LLM hybrid pipeline.
- Persists extracted facts to local memory files (WARM_MEMORY.md, MEMORY.md, ontology, USER.md) in the background.
- Supports automatic operation on session end, scheduled backfill, and manual runs.
- Includes customizable extraction rules and destination mapping.
- Designed for local-first, single-user workflows with hands-off fact extraction.
